usedFor: Portfolio Manager holds projects and tasks, and Google Docs records changes through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New or Changed Task” in Portfolio Manager, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each task change is written to a doc, giving stakeholders a readable change log.

watchOut: “New or Changed Task” also fires on edits, so one task can write several entries.
